dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Compared to the constant hubbub of Liyue Harbor, it is far more serene here.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: It is a pleasant and leisurely atmosphere, not unfit for a festival.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: On the way over, I saw grandparents preparing meals, children learning to make Xiao Lanterns... It was quite nostalgic for me. It took me back to the very earliest days of Liyue's history.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Back then, most able-bodied adults were busy supporting the war effort or helping to build the city. Like now, the oldest and youngest supported each other, living humble lives.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It sounds like they had it rough...

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Indeed, their lives were not easy. But the people of Liyue have tenacity and optimism in their bones.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: They will never stop striving for progress, no matter how much destitution they face.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: In ancient times, Qingce Village was once ravaged by the Chi. It is now several thousand years since it was put to rest.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Over the millennia, people built dwellings and worked the fertile land, creating the spectacular view we now see today.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I heard a story about the Chi's corpse...

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: ...That after it died, its body became the rocky mountains and flowing waters of Qingce. I, too, have heard this story.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: The idea is captivating. Though, I'm afraid, it is pure fantasy.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Lofty mountains have stood and spring water has flowed here since time immemorial. That people now inhabit this place is solely because they have toiled to make it so.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Qingce's verdant hills and stunning waters paired with the tranquil atmosphere here make it a place of extraordinary beauty. A rare blessing indeed.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Oh, one of the villagers generously gifted me with some fresh Bamboo Shoots. They will add some seasonal flavor to a meal on my return to Liyue Harbor.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Seasonal bamboo shoots are yet another rare blessing offered by Qingce Village.
